acceptanceCovered: New setup, result, closed, and needs-input outputs create Browser widgets with exact workflow title markers, stable artifact URLs, canonical structured records, and durable connectors. — Verified setup/result/closed Browser artifact paths in tests/test_browser_artifacts.py and needs-input path in orchestrator_needs_input.py + tests/test_needs_input_node.py; title markers [EXP:Setup], [EXP:Result], [EXP:Closed], [EXP:Needs Input] are preserved; stable /artifacts/{opaque_id} resource path and stable widget identity are kept while token query may rotate; ArtifactStore records and durable connectors are created/reconciled.

Artifact updates append versions and change rendered content without recreating the Browser widget. — Verified ArtifactStore.append_version preserves history and bumps current_version; artifact_server ETag/rendered content changes after append_version; Browser repair uses update_browser in place rather than recreate, preserving widget id and connector graph.

The HTML renderer escapes all user/model content, rejects raw executable HTML, uses a strict CSP with same-origin assets, and remains responsive and keyboard accessible. — Verified artifact_render.py escapes nested payload/metadata/provenance, only emits same-origin CSS/JS, artifact_http.py applies default-src 'none' CSP, and tests cover XSS strings, no inline handlers/styles, keyboard tabs, reduced motion, responsive overflow, and no third-party assets.

Capability reads use high-entropy opaque identifiers and constant-time token verification; revoked, guessed, unauthorized, and cross-canvas requests expose no artifact data. — Verified secrets.token_urlsafe opaque ids/tokens, SHA-256 token hashes only, hmac.compare_digest with dummy hash, active-token rotation/revocation, ArtifactStore authorized lookup, uniform 404 responses, no canvas/id/token leakage, and artifact service access logs disabled.

Workflow detection accepts generated Browser widgets and legacy Notes while idea and human approval/review input remain Note-only. — Verified canvus_mcp experiment_widgets accepts Note or Browser for generated setup/result/closed/needs-input markers, scan_workflow exposes needs_inputs, ideas require widget_type Note with {idea:}, and tests prove Browser idea/human response Notes are not classified as generated artifacts.

Crash recovery reconciles persisted artifacts, Browser widgets, widget mappings, and connectors without duplicate effects. — Verified durable_browser creates artifact before Browser, probes bucket tags for existing Browser widgets, repairs stale token URLs with update_browser, maps widgets idempotently, connect_durable dedupes connectors, and restart tests cover setup, closed, needs-input, MCP error payloads, and second-restart no-duplicate behavior.

Legacy generated Notes can be inventoried and mirrored idempotently in dry-run-first mode, with no deletion by default. — Verified migration script defaults to read-only inventory, apply is explicit, original Notes/connectors are never deleted/edited, Browser mirrors carry canonical import payload/provenance, connectors are mirrored once, reruns converge and repair token URLs, and operator output excludes capability URLs/tokens.

Both applications pass pytest, ruff, and mypy; security, large-payload, graph, restart, accessibility, and migration paths have regression coverage. — Verified canonical and raw temper evidence: 9/9 commands exit 0, canvus-mcp 37 tests passed, lab-agent 256 tests passed, both ruff and mypy suites clean, workflow parity self-test/full check clean, git diff --check clean; additionally re-ran focused Phase 3 regression tests locally (24 lab-agent tests and 16 canvus-mcp tests passed).

README, architecture, workflow, operations, standards, roadmap, changelog, and canonical use-case documentation describe the implemented service and deployment constraints. — Verified README.md and docs/code-standards.md, development-roadmap.md, experiment-workflow.md, lab-in-the-loop-use-case-specification.md, project-changelog.md, setup-and-operations.md, and system-architecture.md document Browser artifacts, legacy Notes, Note-only human inputs, stable resource path vs rotating token query, capability secrecy, migration, backup, HTTPS/private ingress, and no live TLS/Canvus reachability claim.
